responsibility: This definition module declares Logitech-compatible bit operations for a single SYSTEM.WORD. It defines the public API for bit-field extraction and update, wordwise logical operators, shifts, rotates, arithmetic right shift, and byte-oriented helpers such as HighByte, LowByte, and Swap, making it the word-sized counterpart of BitByteOps and BitBlockOps.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface half of the BitWordOps pair, declaring WORD-based bit-field, logical, shift, rotate, and byte-extraction routines; the companion BitWordOps.mod provides the working code and direct byte-addressing needed for helpers such as HighByte, LowByte, and Swap.
